latest.headline: Blue wave hits AI infrastructure; MU indicated about 2.5% lower
latest.tldr: Democrats won both chambers, and a Texas governor who has promised a data-center moratorium won too. That pulled money out of the AI build-out trade overnight. Nasdaq futures faded to about flat by 8:45 ET while the Dow rallied, and MU slid from +1.4% early to about −2.6% ($832.78) by 8:30 ET, even though AMD, Arista and Super Micro all beat.
